articles.summary: IBM Maximo Application Suite - Location Service for Esri Component 9.2, 9.1, and 9.0 is vulnerable to command injection due to improper sanitisation of a user-controlled value passed to a shell command in a Kubernetes operator task.

articles.title: CVE-2026-18517 — CVSS 7.7

articles.summary: IBM Maximo Application Suite - Location Service for Esri Component 9.2, 9.1, and 9.0 is vulnerable to improper access control due to a schema-less Custom Resource Definition.

articles.title: CVE-2026-16678 — CVSS 4.5
articles.summary: IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1110.00 through FW1110.31, FW1120.00 through FW1120.01, and FW1060.00 through FW1060.81 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service by exhausting connection resources due to improper resource management.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109569 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: sandboxed.sh through 1.3.0 contains a container escape vulnerability that allows code in container workspaces to access the host filesystem because nsenter attaches without --root. Agent-run code in a container workspace can resolve absolute paths on the host to read and modify host files, bypassing documented isolation.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109568 — CVSS 7.1
articles.summary: Shaark 1.2.13 through 1.2.44 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Link, Story, Chest and Album API controllers that skips ownership checks. Authenticated non-admin users can send PUT or DELETE requests to /api/{link,story,chest,album}/{id} with numeric IDs to overwrite or delete other users' content, including private items.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109567 — CVSS 7.2
articles.summary: Rapyd Admin from 9.0.0 before 9.20.0 contains an improper privilege management vulnerability in the UsersEdit Livewire component that allows users with the edit users permission to assign themselves the admin role. Attackers holding roles such as the shipped operator role can submit the admin role ID for their own account, lifting tenant scoping, bypassing per-record authorization, and enabling im

articles.title: CVE-2026-109566 — CVSS 9.8
articles.summary: Rapyd Admin from 9.0.0 before 9.20.0 contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to gain super-admin access through an AuthSeeder-created admin@laravel account with password admin. The account is seeded by the setup installer and silently re-created on every rpd:make run, letting attackers log in as a global super admin bypassing per-record authoriz

articles.title: CVE-2026-109565 — CVSS 6.1
articles.summary: Rapyd Admin from 9.4.0 before 9.20.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through self-registered display names. Attackers can register with an HTML or JavaScript name rendered unescaped in the Activity log Author filter, executing in an administrator's session.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109564 — CVSS 3.1
articles.summary: LearnHouse before 1.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in POST /api/v1/playgrounds/{uuid}/duplicate that skips the read-access and draft checks enforced by get_playground. Authenticated users with playground creation rights, such as Instructors, who know a RESTRICTED or unpublished playground UUID can copy its html_content and republish it publicly.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109563 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: N3.js before 2.11.1 contains a regular expression denial of service vulnerability in the N3Lexer number pattern that backtracks quadratically on long digit runs. Attackers can supply untrusted Turtle or N3 input containing long runs of digits that do not end a number, blocking the Node.js event loop and causing denial of service.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109562 — CVSS 5.4
articles.summary: SnapOtter 1.15.10 through 2.2.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated principal to call the /api/v1/upload, /api/v1/preview and /api/v1/preview/generate handlers without permission checks. Attackers holding even a settings:read-scoped API key can stage arbitrary files outside storage quota, served unauthenticated via /api/v1/download, and feed crafted input t

articles.title: CVE-2026-109560 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: Continue CLI (@continuedev/cli) through 1.5.47 contains a permission bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to run unapproved commands by chaining them after allowed Bash prefix rules. Attackers can inject instructions into repository files or fetched pages so the agent appends commands after ;, && or | to execute code as the user.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109559 — CVSS 8.7
articles.summary: EdgeEver Desktop 1.6.26 through 1.112.0 contains a navigation allowlist bypass that lets attackers load arbitrary origins in the main window via string-prefix URL matching. Attackers can embed a link using userinfo syntax after the dev-server prefix, for example in a note-template preview, to obtain the edgeeverDesktop bridge including session token, sidecar RPC, and ACP channels.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109558 — CVSS 8.7
articles.summary: EdgeEver 1.6.0 through 1.112.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in TemplatesPane.tsx that renders template contentMarkdown with raw HTML via dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitization. Attackers can write templates containing HTML event handlers through an API or MCP token to run script on preview and access the privileged window.edgeeverDesktop bridge.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109557 — CVSS 8.7
articles.summary: EdgeEver through 1.112.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in setMemoDragPreview that allows attackers to inject script through notebook names or memo titles. Attackers can set malicious names via MCP create_notebook, rename_notebook or create_memo tools, running script on drag with access to the desktop bridge's session token.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109556 — CVSS 8.0
articles.summary: EdgeEver Desktop 1.92.0 through 1.112.0 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the desktop:acp-probe IPC handler, which lacks a sender check and spawns a caller-supplied input.path executable. Attackers with script execution in a renderer, such as via template-preview or drag-preview stored cross-site scripting, can call probeAcpAdapter to launch local executables with the user's privil

articles.title: CVE-2026-109427 — CVSS 6.5
articles.summary: Telegram-Stremio through 5.1.0 contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated token holders to access arbitrary chat messages by forging unsigned, unauthenticated stream IDs decoded via encode_string/decode_string functions. Attackers can craft or enumerate sequential msg_id values and set a global flag in the stream_handler endpoint to route requests through

articles.title: CVE-2026-109426 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: Telegram-Stremio through 5.1.0 contains an insecure storage vulnerability that allows attackers with access to the MongoDB database, backups, or logs to recover the operator's authenticated Telegram session string, which is protected only by a keyless, reversible encoding transform rather than actual encryption. Attackers can round-trip the stored value through the repository's own decode_string f

articles.title: CVE-2026-109380 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: modern-tar 0.3.5 through 0.8.5 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to produce negative entry sizes via non-octal bytes parsed by readOctal(). Attackers can supply a crafted, optionally gzip-compressed, archive to unpackTar() that buffers chunks indefinitely, exhausting process memory and suppressing later entries.

articles.title: CVE-2026-109379 — CVSS 5.3
articles.summary: Cockpit CMS 2.14.1 contains an observable timing discrepancy vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate accounts due to an incomplete timing fix in /auth/check. Attackers can post login attempts and measure response times, since existing accounts incur two bcrypt operations versus one, revealing valid usernames and email addresses.
